verdicts.claim: GPS eased from 39.2% (FY25) to 37.1% (FY26) on frozen CY25 wallet — sales −€20K while fleet −2.4%.
verdicts.implication: Not mainly a denominator story. Numerator (purchases) fell harder than the parc.

verdicts.claim: Fiscal warranty expense jumped to €102,418 in FY26 (from €225 FY24).
verdicts.implication: Part of the GPS softness may be warranty-coded demand, not lost commercial share — still ISZE billing, different economics.

verdicts.claim: CY2025 PMS total capture ~19% qty-weighted; fuel filter and brake pad trail network by 15–30 pp for three years.
verdicts.implication: Structural under-capture of service demand, not a one-year blip. Wear parts + fuel filter are the fight.

verdicts.claim: AIM high-risk match rate sits ~2–4% of billing — Priority target quadrant is low GPS + low PMS, not high AIM undercut.
verdicts.implication: Don't lead with Eucon/AIM street fight. Lead with own-network capture failure (jobs not bought through AW).
